title: Cernoziom, no irrigation, coldest site in the set, mid-September
rationale: Turda is the cold case: day-0 tMax 17.3 °C (the lowest of the six captured briefs), 99.5 frost days per year on the ten-year mean and a coldest-month normal tMin of -4.2 °C, both the harshest in the set. Winter hardiness therefore separates the cereals: grau_toamna and secara both have frost_tolerance_c_min -20, orz_toamna only -15, so barley is ranked below both. grau_toamna is in the top on cernoziom suitability. rapita_toamna is excluded because its Transylvania window (08-25 → 09-05) closed before the case date and the only open window on 2026-09-13 is the southern one; its frost_tolerance_c_min of -15 is a second, weaker reason.
